metadata.question: Was there an algae bloom visible off the coast of Santa Monica on October 10,  2015?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about an algae bloom visible off the coast of Santa Monica on October 10, 2015. For algae blooms, I should use satellite imagery that can detect chlorophyll concentrations or water color changes. Sentinel-2 would be a good choice as it has good spatial resolution and bands suitable for water quality monitoring. Strategy: 1. Use Sentinel-2 imagery for October 10, 2015 2. Focus on the coastal area near Santa Monica 3. Calculate a chlorophyll index or use true color to visually detect algae blooms 4. Check if there are elevated chlorophyll levels or visible discoloration For algae detection, I can use: - True color visualization to see discoloration - NDCI (Normalized Difference Chlorophyll Index) = (B5 - B4) / (B5 + B4) - Or simple band ratios like B5/B4 that are sensitive to chlorophyll I need to: 1. Define Santa Monica coastal area 2. Get Sentinel-2 imagery for the specific date 3. Check if collection has data 4. Calculate chlorophyll-sensitive indices 5. Determine if values indicate algae bloom Typical algae bloom indicators: - High chlorophyll concentrations - Visible green/brown discoloration in true color - NDCI values > 0.1-0.2 can indicate elevated chlorophyll ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const santaMonicaCoast = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.4952, 34.0100]).buffer(5000); const targetDate = '2015-10-10'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for algae detection let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(santaMonicaCoast) .filterDate(targetDate, ee.Date(targetDate).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images on ${targetDate}: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No Sentinel-2 data available for target date."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Get best image (least cloudy) const image = collection.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); // 4. Calculate NDCI for chlorophyll detection const ndci = image.normalizedDifference(['B5', 'B4']).rename('NDCI'); // 5. Analyze water pixels only (mask land) const waterMask = image.select('B3').lt(0.15); // Simple water mask using blue band // 6. Count valid water pixels and calculate mean NDCI const stats = ndci.updateMask(waterMask).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: santaMonicaCoast, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanNdci = stats.get('NDCI_mean').getInfo(); const pixelCount = stats.get('NDCI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid water pixels: ${pixelCount}`); console.log(`Mean NDCI: ${meanNdci ? meanNdci.toFixed(3) : 'None'}`); // 7. Validation & Final Answer if (meanNdci === null || pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (isNaN(meanNdci)) { console.log("C3"); } else { // NDCI > 0.1 typically indicates elevated chlorophyll (potential algae bloom) const bloomDetected = meanNdci > 0.1; console.log(`Algae bloom threshold (NDCI > 0.1): ${bloomDetected}`); console.log(bloomDetected ? "A" : "B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
